newsitem.title: USA: Dissidents applaud Rexene tender extension.
newsitem.headline: Dissidents applaud Rexene tender extension.

text.p: Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg on Wednesday said they welcomed a decision by Rexene Corp to extended the expiration date for its Dutch auction tender offer to June 19, 1997.
The offer was previously scheduled to expire on May 29.

Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellog are dissident shareholders of Rexene and have backed a change in Rexene's by-laws to make it easier to sell the company and also replace Rexene's board. Combined, they control around 13 percent of Rexene shares.
The two companies said they hoped Rexene would sign an acquisition agreement with the privately-held Huntsman Corp by the new expiration date.
Earlier this month, Rexene said it was in discussions with the Huntsman Corp regarding the acqusiition of Rexene for $16 per share.
